data: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay.
Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage.
Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.
Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability.
This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.
Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.
Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.
Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.
Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.
Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.
Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.
Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive.
Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs.
The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it.
Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.
Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health.
Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.
Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.
Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.
Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also applies Healing Reduction on the bleeding target.
Swaps health levels with an enemy target. There is a minimum health percentage that enemies can be brought down to and a minimum amount of health received based on victims current health.
On cast, +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s.
Cast a wall that applies slow on enemies it passes through. Erupt the wall to divide the terrain in half and damage nearby enemies.
After casting, press or Ability 3 to erupt the wall early.
Can be Destroyed with Melee Attacks
Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s
Create a time warping wall that stops time for all enemy projectiles and bullets that touch it and increases the speed and damage of friendly bullets.
Enemies that touch the wall will be briefly slowed and silenced .
Charge up a powerful shot of time energy, dealing spirit damage and applying a Time-Stop to enemies hit. The damage dealt increases with weapon damage. Move speed is increased while charging.
While in the air and charging, to timeslow your movement.
+2s Charge Hold Duration and +55% Damage Scaling
Briefly become untargetable while teleporting to the target location. Restores stamina upon use.
Throw a grenade that explodes in a cloud of freezing ice that heals allies and applies spirit damage and move speed reduction to enemies.
-10 Cooldown and debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius. Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased.

Throw a dagger that damages and sleeps the target. Sleeping targets wake up shortly after being damaged. Throwing a Dagger does not break your invisibility. Sleep Dagger does not interrupt enemies' channeling abilities.
-10.0% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6.0s on wake-up
-40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up
Fade out of sight, becoming invisible and gaining sprint speed. Attacking removes invisibility, but using items does not. Close enemies can see through your invisibility.
Shooting a target increases your bullet damage on that target. Gain one stack per bullet hit, three if the hit is a headshot.
40.0 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.
Attach a bomb that explodes after a delay, dealing spirit damage to nearby enemies.
If the bomb hits or kills a hero, you gain permanent bonus damage on Sticky Bomb.
Stacks diminish by half after 60 hits and 7 kills
On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s
Launch out a mechanical hand that pulls the first character it hits, reeling them in.
Grapple Arm can be used on allies.
Charge up a powerful shot that pierces through enemies. Hold Ability 1 or to hold the shot.
Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay
After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies. Hold [W] to accelerate the owl.
Press Jump / mantle to release control. Gain permanent Spirit Power for each enemy hero killed with Guided Owl.
After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health
Slash enemies in front of you, damaging them and slowing their fire rate. If any enemy heroes are hit, you heal.
On Hero Hit : +6% Max Health Heal
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs, stealing life from them and causing them to deal reduced damage.
Active: Consume all Djinn Mark's to deal its damage now.

Passive: Your shots apply a Djinn Mark on the target. When the mark expires or is consumed, it deals spirit damage and the target is briefly revealed on the map. Each added mark doubles the current damage.
There is a per target Cooldown for applying additional marks
On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s
Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks
Throw a dagger, dealing spirit damage and applying slow.
Every subsequent dagger against the same target stacks in spirit damage and slow.
On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
You have increased Slide Distance, can Slide up hills, and can turn faster while Sliding.
Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay.
The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.
Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.
Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself.
The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.
Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow
Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow.
After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.
While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet
Send out a luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path.
Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.
-15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact
Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage.
The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup.
Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy.
Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration.
Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally.
You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability.
You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.
35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping
Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.
When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.
-1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling
Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.
Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.
+70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area.
Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets.
Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 30s to 25s, May 19th, 2025.
Previous recorded cooldown change: 35s to 30s, March 6th, 2026.
Parrying is now allowed while ground dashing in order to bring it in-line with air dashing Parry anti mash protection previously would last for 0.25s…
